comments.content:
This change accidentally removes the accumulation of `totalTokenUsage.Prompt` and `totalTokenUsage.Completion`. The diff replaced these two lines with the timing accumulations instead of adding to them. As a result, `PromptTokens`, `CompletionTokens`, and `TotalTokens` in the non-streaming completion response will always be 0. Please restore:

```go
totalTokenUsage.Prompt += tokenUsage.Prompt
totalTokenUsage.Completion += tokenUsage.Completion
totalTokenUsage.TimingTokenGeneration += tokenUsage.TimingTokenGeneration
totalTokenUsage.TimingPromptProcessing += tokenUsage.TimingPromptProcessing
```

The help string is a placeholder (`"TODO: write a help string"`). Please provide a meaningful description for the `LOCALAI_MACHINE_TAG` flag, e.g. explaining that it tags responses via the `LocalAI-Machine-Tag` header and defaults to the machine hostname when unset.
